mapper.sql: create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, id, name, code, status, del_flag, parent_id, ancestors, province_code, city_code, area_code, user_max_count, valid_time, third_tenant_type, third_tenant_id, qps, max_call_times, audit_service_validity_start, audit_service_validity_end
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_tenant SET ancestors = REPLACE(ancestors, #{oldAncestors}, #{newAncestors}) WHERE ancestors LIKE CONCAT(#{childAncestors}, '%')
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM sys_tenant WHERE del_flag = '0'
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyWord}, '%')

SELECT a.create_by "createBy", a.create_time "createTime", a.update_by "updateBy", a.update_time "updateTime", a.id "id", a.NAME "name", a.CODE "code", a.STATUS "status", a.parent_id "parentId", a.valid_time "validTime", a.max_call_times "maxCallTimes", a.qps "qps", CASE WHEN b.NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (CASE WHEN c.NAME IS NULL THEN b.NAME ELSE (CASE WHEN d.NAME IS NULL THEN CONCAT(b.NAME, '/', c.NAME) ELSE CONCAT(b.NAME, '/', c.NAME, '/', d.NAME) END) END) END "areaName", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = a.id AND del_flag = '0') "userCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_role WHERE tenant_id = a.id AND del_flag = '0') "userRoleCount", a.audit_service_validity_start, a.audit_service_validity_end, IF(a.id = 1, 0, 1) AS platformTenant FROM sys_tenant a LEFT JOIN sys_province b ON a.province_code = b.id LEFT JOIN sys_city c ON a.city_code = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_area d ON a.area_code = d.id WHERE a.del_flag = '0'
AND (a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.keyWord}, '%') OR a.id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.keyWord}, '%') OR a.update_by LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.keyWord}, '%'))
AND a.id = #{condition.tenantId}
AND date_format(a.audit_service_validity_start,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{condition.params.beginTime},'%y%m%d')
AND date_format(a.audit_service_validity_start,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{condition.params.endTime},'%y%m%d')

SELECT a.create_by "createBy", a.create_time "createTime", a.update_by "updateBy", a.update_time "updateTime", a.id "id", a.NAME "label", a.CODE "code", a.STATUS "status", a.parent_id "parentId", a.valid_time "validTime", CASE WHEN b.NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (CASE WHEN c.NAME IS NULL THEN b.NAME ELSE (CASE WHEN d.NAME IS NULL THEN CONCAT(b.NAME, '/', c.NAME) ELSE CONCAT(b.NAME, '/', c.NAME, '/', d.NAME) END) END) END "areaName" FROM sys_tenant a LEFT JOIN sys_province b ON a.province_code = b.id LEFT JOIN sys_city c ON a.city_code = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_area d ON a.area_code = d.id WHERE a.del_flag = '0'
AND a.id = #{tenantId}

SELECT a.NAME "tenantName", a.parent_id "parentTenantId", (SELECT NAME FROM sys_tenant WHERE id = a.parent_id) "parentTenantName", b.id "provinceCode", a.id "tenantId", b.NAME "provinceName", c.id "cityCode", c.NAME "cityName", d.id "areaCode", d.NAME "areaName", CASE WHEN b.NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (CASE WHEN c.NAME IS NULL THEN b.NAME ELSE (CASE WHEN d.NAME IS NULL THEN CONCAT(b.NAME, '/', c.NAME) ELSE CONCAT(b.NAME, '/', c.NAME, '/', d.NAME) END) END) END "concatName", a.user_max_count "userMaxCount", a.create_time "createTime", a.update_time "updateTime", a.create_by "createBy", a.update_by "updateBy", a.valid_time "validTime", a.third_tenant_id "thirdTenantId", a.max_call_times "maxCallTimes", a.qps "qps" FROM sys_tenant a LEFT JOIN sys_province b ON a.province_code = b.id LEFT JOIN sys_city c ON a.city_code = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_area d ON a.area_code = d.id WHERE a.id = #{tenantId}
